facts.statement: Account services, including account maintenance and all Station Cash services, were offline for a planned maintenance window of about 2 hours on Thursday, 8 July 2010, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM (TP).
facts.quote: tendrá una duración aproximada de 2 horas este Jueves, 08 de julio del 2010, comenzando a las 10:00 AM hasta las 12:00 PM TP

article_summaries.title: Servicio de Cuentas y Mantenimiento de Comercio – jueves 8 de julio (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: This official freerealms.com notice, written in Spanish, announces a planned maintenance window for account services, all Station Cash services and the purchase catalog. It is a service notice, not gameplay content, and it gives no details of quests, items or mechanics. The page does not name Free Realms in its body; it is included because it sits in the game's official news section.
